errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are not placed at an interval of one quarter; the intervals are irregular (e.g., 2003Q1 is followed by 2004Q2, then 2005Q3).
The description states that the y-axis shows the percentage of unemployment, but no units are specified on the y-axis in the figure.

errors.text_span: Осите са означени съответно като „Общо Безработица“ и с числови стойности
errors.evidence: This incorrectly states that one of the axes is labeled "Общо Безработица". This text is the title of the chart, not an axis label. The x-axis has time-based labels and the y-axis has numerical labels.
The phrase "със спрян маркер" (literally "with a stopped marker") is awkward and unclear in Bulgarian. A clearer way to state that there are no markers would be "без маркери".
The first minimum is reached around 2009Q2, not 2009Q1, and the value is approximately 180-190, not 150.0.
The line is at approximately 180 in 2019Q1, not 150.0. The local minimum is reached later, around 2019Q2, at a value of approximately 130.
The line ends at a value of approximately 150.0 in 2021Q4, not 180.0.
